catalog.summary: Typed date input split into segments.

departures.yearPage: The APG spin-button example steps every button by five. Five years is not a page of years, and the year is the segment a reader is furthest from; ten is the step the calendar's year view uses, so the two agree. The cost is a reader who learned five from another spin button on the page.
departures.noArrowButtons: The APG example is deprecated for its visible increment and decrement buttons, which duplicate keys the reader already has. Its roles, its wrapping rules and its aria-valuetext guidance are the spin-button pattern's and are taken whole. No arrow buttons are drawn.

entryModel.runEndsWhen: the segment is full, or one more digit could not fit under its maximum
entryModel.requestEmittedOn: the end of a run, never inside one
entryModel.keysAreConsumed: a key the field acts on is stopped, not only defaulted
entryModel.whyKeysAreConsumed: Every application that binds a bare key guards it with "is the target an editable element", and that guard tests for input, textarea and contenteditable. A div with role=spinbutton is none of the three, so a reader typing a date fires every single-key shortcut on the page. In Storybook, pressing 1 moved focus out of the story and into the sidebar. preventDefault does not help: a shortcut handler reads the key, not the default.
entryModel.whyRequestWaits: Typing 2026 into a year passes through 2, 20 and 202, and the arithmetic accepts every one of them as a date. A request per digit would ask a consumer's server about the year 2. The segments move on every keystroke and the value moves when the run ends: on the digit that fills the field, on the key that leaves it, or on blur, where a short year resolves through the pivot.
entryModel.wraps: inside the segment, never carrying into the next
entryModel.clearedSegment: the placeholder, and the value becomes null

dataAttributes.data-field: which of year, month or day a segment holds
dataAttributes.data-placeholder: the segment has no value and is drawing its placeholder

literals.--slotted-date-field-segment-min-inline-: A segment is sized from the widest digit its field can hold, which is arithmetic over the control type scale rather than a literal; the floor under the whole control is --slotted-control-height-*, which the theme owns.
